### Find the Right Lock

Tubular or mortise? Not all locks are created equal, and there are several types of keyed locks
including mortise, cylindrical, tubular and rim locks. Learn the difference between the two most
popular lock styles so you can choose the one that best fits your door. Or dive deeper into finding
the right lock.
* [Tubular Lock]
  Tubular
  Tubular or standard door prep is most common in North America. Standard prep requires a 2 1/8”
  diameter bore hole through the door. Baldwin offers a wide array of options of tubular handlesets.
* [Mortise Lock]
  Mortise
  Mortise door preparation is named for the mortised pocket cut into the edge of the door
  (approximately 6" high by 4" deep) and is seen more often on custom and solid wood doors. While
  this does take more expertise to install, this lock type is known for being more heavy duty, and
  secure. Baldwin has had a long tradition of exceptional mortise door locks.

### Find the Right Lock

Tubular or mortise? Not all locks are created equal, and there are several types of keyed locks
including mortise, cylindrical, tubular and rim locks. Learn the difference between the two most
popular lock styles so you can choose the one that best fits your door. Or dive deeper into finding
the right lock.
* [Tubular Lock]
  Tubular
  Tubular or standard door prep is most common in North America. Standard prep requires a 2 1/8”
  diameter bore hole through the door. Baldwin offers a wide array of options of tubular handlesets.
* [Mortise Lock]
  Mortise
  Mortise door preparation is named for the mortised pocket cut into the edge of the door
  (approximately 6" high by 4" deep) and is seen more often on custom and solid wood doors. While
  this does take more expertise to install, this lock type is known for being more heavy duty, and
  secure. Baldwin has had a long tradition of exceptional mortise door locks.

Discover our innovative 3D city model that allows customers to explore our industries in detail. In

personalized experience.

By navigating the city, you can easily access information and demonstrations of our products in

## The Spoke Knob

Be it art, architecture or interior design, Emtek products take inspiration from all walks of
life—including our daily commute. Echoing the wheel of a bicycle, the Spoke Knob is the flagship
piece in the Studio Brass line dedicated to bringing boutique design straight to your door.

[Get a Closer Look][74]

EMTEK DESIGN

## The Galapagos Project

Emtek has developed a computer algorithm, capable of generating patterns that mimic the variations
seen in nature. A limited series of truly unique patterns will be generated and produced with 3D
printed metals. Each 3D printed handle will represent their own variation of The Galapagos Project.
Emulating nature, no two pieces will be identical.

[ [take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being] ][48]

### [ take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being ][49]

what if form didn't follow function, but pleasure? long before we built anything, we played, turning
a cardboard box into a spaceship and a patch of floor into an ocean. play here is not frivolity, but
our first creative act, the moment imagination learns that reality is negotiable. this chapter
explores what happens when we design not to save time, but to spend it well, rejecting efficiency as
the highest virtue in favor of warmth, spontaneity, and joy. to choose delight while the world feels
heavy is not to look away from it, but to remember what makes it worth carrying.

by sofia lekka angelopoulou

### ABOUT INDIA INTERNATIONAL HOUSE LTD.

# Building Excellence Since 1976

Since 1976, India International House Ltd. has manufactured architectural and builder hardware and
precision components with the same commitment to durability and design. From door handles and hinges
to custom-engineered brackets, housings, and extruded profiles, our products are trusted by leading
brands, OEMs, and project partners worldwide.

With vertically integrated manufacturing, skilled craftsmanship, and strict quality systems, we
deliver reliable solutions that perform consistently, batch after batch, shipment after shipment.

## Responsible Manufacturing

Our operations are designed to minimize impact and maximize efficiency:

Eco-friendly surface care systems reduce chemical use and conserve water.

Effluent treatment plants across all units ensure safe treatment and discharge of wastewater.

Induction furnaces lower energy consumption and emissions compared to conventional methods.

Trivalent chrome facilities provide a safer, more environmentally responsible plating process.

Sustainable packaging is developed to minimize material waste and support recyclability.

# Certified & Audit-Ready

Our facilities and processes meet international quality and compliance standards:
* ISO 9001:2015: Quality Management
* ISO 14001:2015: Environmental Management
* ISO 45001:2018: Occupational Health & Safety
* RoHS Compliant: Safe materials and finishes
* SMETA / C-TPAT: Ethical trade and secure supply chains

# [ Enger - Manufacturer of door handles ][72]

Enger company is a manufacturer and general distributor of door handles and accessories under the
brands APRILE, STILE, and STERK. Since 1996, Enger has been consistently observing global interior
design trends, promoting functional designs that meet the expectations and needs of European
customers.

[ Learn more ][73]
Enger

## [ Architects ][74]

Collaboration with designers, architects, and interior designers is extremely important to us. We
have focused on facilitating your work and have provided libraries of our 3D models, which will save
you time during visualizations

building brand images. His goal is to align the product with the needs by observing trends and

## [ Kabo & Pydo ][90]

Kabo & Pydo is a Warsaw-based design and strategy studio founded in 2012 by Kasia Kabo and Tomek
Pydo, graduates of ASP Warsaw and Politecnico di Milano.

[ Read more ][91]

## About Us

For over two decades, Enger has been promoting innovative and functional solutions that combine the
highest quality with aesthetics and ergonomics. Our products are characterized not only by excellent
design but also by durability and reliability, making them the perfect choice for the most demanding
customers.

The brands **APRILE**, **STILE**, and **STERK** are synonymous with elegance and modernity,
seamlessly fitting into a variety of interior designs, from classic to contemporary. Our attention
to detail and continuous improvement of our offerings have earned us the trust of a wide range of
customers, both in Poland and internationally.

Enger is not just a manufacturer of door handles; we are a partner dedicated to supporting our
clients in realizing their visions and interior design projects. Our mission is to provide solutions
that enhance spaces, highlighting their unique character and style.

We guarantee the highest quality craftsmanship and user comfort of every sold door handle.

# Welcome to Gedore Lock Industries

### Established in the year 1992 “Gedore Lock Industries”.

The Gedore story began in 1992 with the manufacture of locks. Since then, Gedore locks industries
have brought many innovative products in the lacks industry. with the experience of 25 years in the
market, the company has set major challenges for the competition regarding the best quality product
and fast services from a state-of-the-art manufacturing and trading facility in Aligarh, Gedore
locks industries providing locking solutions that reach home, office, industries, and several parts
of India.

[More About Us][31]

## Our Products

Our locks manufacturing Company has many modern products. We have almost 25 years of experience in
the market, and have set major challenges for the competition by committed to providing the best
quality product and fast services from a state-of-the-art manufacturing and trading facility in
Aligarh. We manufacture and supply a range of locks for home, office, industries. Our products reach
different parts of the country. As one of the renowned locks manufacturing companies, we have come a
long way in delivering the best locking solutions.

Our locks are used in lockers, metal panels, furniture, and electrical units. We offer a broad
variety of unique stylish locks all over in India. These locks are mostly installed at smaller and
medium-duty safes. They are known for durability, quality, and functionality. We can make the best
quality of furniture locks. These locks are offered with a combination of different keys as per your
requirement. These Locks are used in different applications.

**Features**

Available with master key system

Also used as cabinet locks

Rust-resistant body

Customization

When you select a [**Best Quality Glass lock Manufacturers**][32], you can be sure you've done the
job right, the first time, because these days our products are the strong and reliable. In addition,
our locks are very easy to fix, and simple to repair and maintain. These locks provide total safety
and security for our customers.

As a leading name in the industry, we keep a regular vigil at every stage of manufacturing to ensure
the quality and reliability of our products. The best quality raw material is used to maintain the
quality of our products which is our hallmark in the market.

**Our range of locking systems is broad. We can offer:**
* Door locks
* Cupboard locks
* Glass locks
* Padlocks
* Multi-purpose locks
* Heavy-duty interlocks
* Sliding locks
* And other special locks.


We provide locking systems to leading manufacturers of **lockers, safes, wooden and metal office
furniture, medical furniture, roof racks, roof boxes, postal boxes**, and many more. Our products
can be found in the home, in hospitals, schools, and places of work, in fact anywhere where a
locking solution is needed. We can design and manufacture locks to your specifications and
application need.

We manufacture the best quality locks and our products are now reaching different parts of the
country.. Our creation efforts for advance research and on-time delivering ensure our customer's
requirement. We are supported by highly-qualified team of experts to manufacture the **best quality
locks** at affordable prices. Our employees are prepared with all the latest devices to manufacture

* **18 years** of experience in door craftsmanship.

Because we operate **direct from factory**, without middlemen or showroom markups — giving you
**better value** for the same or **higher quality.**

    The Whirlpool system consists of a water pump, water return, heater and jets. Stable flow,

    jets, a diverter tube that ensures even distribution of the airflow, and a check valve that
    prevents backflow.
    
    SPA water feature systems combine waterfalls with laminar jets to create stunning visual
    effects.
    
    The SPA audio-visual system includes Bluetooth speakers and one TV. Users can play music or
    radio wirelessly, while the TV plays the user's favorite content.
    
    The SPA Peripheral Support System includes a spa cover, lifter, steps, handrails and caddy. The
    cover locks in the heat while the lifter allows easy removal of the cover. Steps and handrails
    ensure safe entry and exit, and the bar allows users to enjoy a drink.

    functions, and control panel for users to operate the spa bathtub with one button.
    
    In the SPA circulation system, the filter cartridge is placed in the filter to play a filtering
    role, the suction and circulation pump for water circulation, the heater is used for constant
    temperature, the ozone generator and UV lamps are used for sterilization and disinfection.
    
    SPA sterilization system includes ozone generator and UV lamp for sterilization.
    
    The SPA thermostat system consists of a heater that heats the water and maintains the water
    temperature at a constant level.
    
    The SPA framing system includes skirt boards for the bottom and perimeter of the spa hot tub.
    
    The SPA LED light system utilizes LED pool lights, mini lights, luminous nozzles and skirt
    strips. The LED lights provide uniform illumination, the mini lights highlight design details,
    and the glowing nozzles and skirting strips add a luminous ambient effect.

# Do More^{™}

From curb appeal to cozy interiors, our doors bring comfort, beauty and connection to every space in
the home.

## Doors designed to make life and living better

solutions

At Masonite, we create Doors That Do More™ for the people who pass through them every day. We
believe doors should connect you with the people and things you care about most — and make life
easier, safer and more beautiful, too.

[

### Doors that reduce noise

Keep sound where it belongs—in or out of a room—with sound-dampening doors.

Learn more ][40]
[
[Modern entry way with a blue exterior front door with three panels and silver handle the house has
brown wood paneling wall on one side and a plain white wall with a long window and trees]

### Doors that enhance safety

Feel safer and more secure with integrated features like multipoint locks or fire- and impact-rated
doors.

Learn more ][41]
[
[A young girl walking through gray double front doors, each with 3/4 lite glass pane]

### Doors that increase light

Bring natural light into your home with doors that have more visible glass area.

Learn more ][42]
[

### Doors that conserve energy

Stay comfortable inside, whatever the weather is outside, with an exterior door system that provides
better protection from the elements.

][43]
[

### Doors that elevate style

Complement your home’s design with our curated collection of doors for the whole home.

][44]

## Un catalogo con più di 100 maniglie

#### Il catalogo Olivari è composto da più di 100 maniglie e presenta pezzi storici, best-sellers
#### intramontabili e novità firmate dai più grandi designers e architetti internazionali.

### Maniglie Square

La serie Square si caratterizza per la forma quadrata delle componenti tecniche (rosetta, bocchetta,
placca, …) e per la geometria a sviluppo lineare delle impugnature.

### Maniglie Round

La serie Round si caratterizza per la forma tonda delle componenti tecniche (rosetta, bocchetta,
placca, …) e per la geometria variabile delle impugnature.

### Maniglie Special

I prodotti della seria Special si caratterizzano per ricercatezza e originalità di forme e materiali
delle impugnature.

## Security starts
## with Trust.

Remember that question that started the whole thing? *Why do so many locks feel like they’re made
for the wrong people?* It was true, wasn’t it? Either you got some complicated garbage that required
an engineering degree just to change a battery, or you had something so basic you basically left a
welcome mat out for thieves. The security industry was stuck in this awful, expensive loop.

The team behind **Trilogy Locks**—installers, engineers, managers, everyone—they’d *lived* that
frustration. They knew there had to be a way to have **security** that didn’t get in the way of
actually running a business. So, they went out and built it. Not in some pristine, imaginary lab,
but right there, in the field, solving actual problems.

That’s why these **trilogy door locks** and **alarm lock systems** are trusted by everyone from
hospitals to small offices, honestly. It’s about **reliability**. A **keypad** that works, a door
that locks when it should. It’s a system you don’t have to think about, which, when you’re talking
about safety and time, is basically **everything**. No drama, no manuals needed, just security that
scales up or down with you. It’s security that respects your time. That’s the point.

## Your Questions. Straight Answers

#### What makes Trilogy Locks different from standard key locks?

Trilogy Locks offer keypad and electronic access systems that give you more control—no lost keys,
easy code changes, and options for scheduled or limited access.

#### Are Trilogy Locks hard to install?

Not at all. Most models are designed for straightforward retrofitting and can often be installed
using existing door prep.

#### Can I manage multiple doors with Trilogy Locks?

Yes. Many Trilogy models support multi-door programming and remote updates through software
networks, depending on the system.

#### Do I need special software to manage the locks?

Some advanced models offer software integration for managing users and schedules, but basic
standalone versions work right out of the box with no extra setup.

#### What happens if the power goes out?

Trilogy Locks are battery-powered, so they remain fully functional during outages. You’ll also get
low-battery alerts in advance.

#### Can I use Trilogy Locks for both interior and exterior doors?

Yes. Trilogy Locks are built for commercial-grade performance, with weather-resistant models
available for exterior use.

### The story of our roots: a journey to the origins of Viefe

At Viefe we were born from wood. Our essence comes from the boxwood forests of the Ges valley, our
land. Our roots are in the nature and craftsmanship. We are heirs to the tradition of the family
joinery business that has marked the history of Sant Pere de Torelló (Barcelona), and also our own.
We are proud of our past, of the people who made it possible and of the entrepreneurial spirit that
has brought us this far.

We work with internationally renowned designers to create cutting-edge decorative accessories. With
the help of their aesthetic sensitivity, we develop products that are as functional as they are
extraordinary. 
[Meet our designers][59]

### Down to the smallest detail

Quality is our top priority. Quality in our production processes, in every detail of our decorative
accessories, in the service we offer, in our management, and in every action that we take to make
sure our customers are happy to have chosen us.
[This is our philosophy][60]

HISTORY DESIGNERS QUALITY

### The story of our roots: a journey to the origins of Viefe

At Viefe we were born from wood. Our essence comes from the boxwood forests of the Ges valley, our
land. Our roots are in the nature and craftsmanship. We are heirs to the tradition of the family
joinery business that has marked the history of Sant Pere de Torelló (Barcelona), and also our own.
We are proud of our past, of the people who made it possible and of the entrepreneurial spirit that
has brought us this far.

### We believe in good design

We work with internationally renowned designers to create cutting-edge decorative accessories. With
the help of their aesthetic sensitivity, we develop products that are as functional as they are
extraordinary. 
[Meet our designers][59]

### Down to the smallest detail

Quality is our top priority. Quality in our production processes, in every detail of our decorative
accessories, in the service we offer, in our management, and in every action that we take to make
sure our customers are happy to have chosen us.
[This is our philosophy][60]
